subject: English
text: What action did the postmaster take to keep Lencho's faith in God unshaken?
explanation: The postmaster decided to answer the letter, collecting money from his employees and friends to send to Lencho as an act of charity.

options.text: He decided to answer the letter and collected money to send to Lencho.
He went to Lencho's house to explain the reality.
He threw the letter in the wastebasket.
He reported Lencho's case to the local police.

subject: English
text: The political system of 'Apartheid' in South Africa was characterized by:
explanation: Apartheid was a political system that separated people based on their racial groups, leading to deep oppression of black people.

options.text: Racial segregation and discrimination against black people.
Equal voting rights and representation for all races.
Economic cooperation between neighboring nations.
A socialist economy managed by the government.

subject: English
text: What treatment did Dr. Herriot prescribe for Tricki during the first two days of his hospital stay?
explanation: Dr. Herriot gave Tricki no food at all but provided him with plenty of water to help his digestive system recover.

options.text: No food and plenty of water.
High protein diet and medicines.
Fruit juices and vitamin pills.
Daily surgeries and physical exercises.

subject: English
text: In Robert Frost's poem 'Fire and Ice', what does the element 'Fire' represent?
explanation: Fire symbolizes desire, greed, lust, conflict, and passion which can consume and destroy humanity.

options.text: Desire and greed
Reason and logic
Love and affection
Indifference and hatred

subject: English
text: Why did Hari Singh change his name every month in 'The Thief's Story'?
explanation: Hari Singh changed his name monthly to keep ahead of the police and escape his former employers.

options.text: To escape the police and his former employers.
Because he forgot his real name.
To impress the people he met in town.
Because it was a religious tradition.

subject: English
text: Fill in the blank with the correct determiner: Only ________ students managed to pass the exceptionally hard exam.
explanation: 'A few' has a positive meaning implying a small number of (countable) students who passed.

options.text: a few
few
little
a little

subject: English
text: What was the topic of the second essay assigned to Anne Frank by Mr. Keesing?
explanation: After she kept talking despite warnings, Mr. Keesing gave her a second essay titled 'An Incorrigible Chatterbox'.

options.text: An Incorrigible Chatterbox
A Chatterbox
Quack, Quack, Quack
The Patience of Paper

subject: English
text: In 'His First Flight', how many siblings did the young seagull have?
explanation: The young seagull had two brothers and one sister, all of whom had already learned to fly.

options.text: Two brothers and one sister
One brother and one sister
Two brothers and two sisters
Three brothers

subject: English
text: In the poem 'A Tiger in the Zoo', what is the tiger's primary activity inside his cage?
explanation: The tiger stalks the few steps of his cage, slow and quiet, ignoring visitors in his confined space.

options.text: Stalking the quiet length of his cage.
Roaring at the zookeepers for food.
Playing with other tigers in the enclosure.
Entertaining visitors with tricks.

subject: English
text: Choose the correct indirect form of: She said, 'I will go to Delhi tomorrow.'
explanation: In indirect speech, 'said' remains 'said', 'will' changes to 'would', and adverb of time 'tomorrow' changes to 'the next day' or 'the following day'.

options.text: She said that she would go to Delhi the next day.
She told that she will go to Delhi tomorrow.
She said that she will go to Delhi the next day.
She said that she would go to Delhi tomorrow.

subject: English
text: In 'The Midnight Visitor', how did Max manage to enter Ausable's room before Ausable arrived?
explanation: Max used a passkey (duplicate key) to enter the room quietly and wait for Ausable.

options.text: He used a passkey to unlock the door.
He climbed up the balcony outside the window.
The waiter opened the door for him.
He broke the window lock and entered.

subject: English
text: In 'Madam Rides the Bus', what was the distance from Valli's village to the nearest town?
explanation: The distance from Valli's village to the nearest town was six miles, taking forty-five minutes by bus.

options.text: Six miles
Ten miles
Three miles
Eight miles

subject: English
text: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb: The committee ________ divided in their opinions.
explanation: When a collective noun like 'committee' acts as individuals showing differences in opinions, it takes a plural verb ('were' / 'are').

options.text: were
was
is
has been

subject: English
text: In 'A Question of Trust', what was Horace Danby's age, and what was his occupation?
explanation: Horace was about fifty years old, unmarried, and ran a successful business making locks with two assistants.

options.text: About fifty years old, lockmaker.
Thirty-five years old, jeweler.
Forty years old, security guard.
Fifty years old, bookkeeper.

subject: English
text: In 'The Ball Poem', where does the boy's ball ultimately land?
explanation: The poet sees the ball bouncing merrily down the street and then falling into the water of the harbor.

options.text: Into the water of the harbor.
Inside a neighbor's garden.
Under a moving cart.
Into a deep sewage drain.

subject: English
text: At what stage of his life did Richard Ebright start collecting butterflies and other items?
explanation: Richard Ebright started collecting butterflies, coins, fossils, and rocks when he was in kindergarten in Reading, Pennsylvania.

options.text: In kindergarten
In high school
In university
During middle school

subject: English
text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate modal verb: Students ________ submit their assignments before Friday as it is compulsory.
explanation: 'Must' is used to express strong necessity or logical obligation, which fits a compulsory deadline.

options.text: must
might
can
would

subject: English
text: In 'The Necklace', what was the occupation of Matilda's husband, M. Loisel?
explanation: M. Loisel was a minor official (clerk) in the office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Public Instruction.

options.text: Clerk in the Ministry of Public Instruction
Director of a local school board
Secretary to the Mayor of Paris
A wealthy merchant in the city

subject: English
text: What is the subject of the second argument between Lomov and Natalya in 'The Proposal'?
explanation: Their second argument starts when Lomov mentions his dog Guess, which Natalya claims is inferior to her dog Squeezer.

options.text: The superiority of their respective hunting dogs, Guess and Squeezer.
The boundaries of the Birchwoods land.
The health conditions of Lomov's aunt.
The dowry amount offered by Chubukov.

subject: English
text: In the poem 'Amanda!', why does Amanda imagine herself as a mermaid drifting in the sea?
explanation: Amanda wants to escape the rules and nagging of her parents. She dreams of being the sole inhabitant of a quiet, green sea, drifting blissfully.

options.text: To live alone in a quiet, emerald sea and escape parental control.
Because she wants to learn how to swim.
She wants to collect sea pearls and diamonds.
To search for a lost pirate ship in the ocean.

subject: English
text: In 'Bholi', what did Bishamber Nath demand as a condition for marrying Bholi when he saw her face?
explanation: Bishamber saw pockmarks on Bholi's face and demanded a cash sum of five thousand rupees as dowry to marry her.

options.text: Five thousand rupees in cash
A share in Ramlal's agricultural land
A newly built house in the village
Gold jewelry worth ten thousand rupees

subject: English
text: In 'Glimpses of India', why were Rajvir and Pranjol traveling to Assam?
explanation: Pranjol had invited his classmate Rajvir to spend the summer vacation at his home. Pranjol's father was the manager of a tea garden in Upper Assam.

options.text: Pranjol's father was a manager of a tea garden, and he invited Rajvir for summer vacation.
They were on a school research project to study tea production.
They wanted to invest in a new tea export business.
They were traveling to attend Pranjol's brother's wedding.

subject: English
text: Choose the correct indirect form of: My friend said, 'Please lend me your book.'
explanation: Imperative sentences containing 'please' indicate requests, so reporting verb becomes 'requested', pronoun shifts ('me' -> 'him'), and verb takes infinitive 'to' form ('to lend').

options.text: My friend requested me to lend him my book.
My friend ordered me to lend him his book.
My friend asked me that please lend him my book.
My friend requested me to lending him your book.

subject: English
text: Where did Belinda live in the humorous poem 'The Tale of Custard the Dragon'?
explanation: Belinda lived in a little white house along with her four pets and a little red wagon.

options.text: In a little white house
In a stone castle on a hill
In a wooden cottage near a forest
In a large manor in London

text: Who is the ruler of Mars in the science-fiction play 'The Book That Saved the Earth'?
explanation: The Martian commander-in-chief and ruler is the Great and Mighty Think-Tank, who is proud but highly foolish.

Apprentice Noodle
Captain Omega
